summary: 6 checks passed (0 failed) covering all 6 acceptance criteria for the account-menu / dark-mode / demo-logout feature. All UI-facing, so no backend test artifacts were needed. No bugs found; one screenshot-timing false-positive was diagnosed and ruled out during investigation (see notes).
notes: During dark-mode verification, an initial screenshot taken immediately after toggling appeared to show a still-light dashboard even though computed styles already reported dark colors. Adding a double requestAnimationFrame wait before screenshotting confirmed this was a screenshot/paint timing artifact in the test script, not a real rendering bug -- the dashboard shell, sidebar, header, cards, and account menu all correctly switch to a dark palette (verified via computed backgroundColor on aside/header/root plus visual screenshots).

checks.criterion: Clicking the top-right AM avatar opens a compact solid dropdown beneath it
checks.name: account-menu-opens-with-profile
checks.evidence: Clicked header-account-menu-button; header-account-menu became visible with header-account-menu-name='Aarav Mehta', header-account-menu-role containing 'Finance lead', header-theme-toggle-label='Dark mode', header-logout-label='Logout'; menu background-color was non-transparent (solid surface)

checks.criterion: The Dark mode menu action changes the whole financial dashboard theme
checks.name: dark-mode-changes-dashboard-theme
checks.evidence: After clicking header-theme-toggle, html gained class 'dark'; computed backgroundColor of the app shell root (div.min-h-screen) = rgb(8,13,24), <aside> = rgb(17,24,39), <header> = rgb(17,24,39) -- all dark and none classified as light by luminance check; reopened account menu showed solid dark, non-transparent background and header-theme-toggle-state='On'

checks.criterion: Theme selection persists in the browser
checks.name: theme-persists-on-reload
checks.evidence: Enabled dark mode, then page.reload(); after reload html.dark class still present, localStorage['razorpay-ai-theme']==='dark', and computed backgroundColor of app shell root remained dark (luminance <200) confirming full dashboard re-renders dark post-reload

checks.criterion: The theme control can restore light mode
checks.name: dark-mode-toggle-restores-light
checks.evidence: With dark mode on, clicked header-theme-toggle again; html.dark class removed, app shell root backgroundColor luminance >200 (light), and reopened menu showed header-theme-toggle-state='Off'

checks.criterion: Logout communicates the demo-only behavior selected by the user
checks.name: logout-shows-demo-session-ended
checks.evidence: Clicked header-logout-button; toast text 'Demo session ended' became visible; primary-navigation remained visible/usable and clicking nav-reconciliation successfully navigated to /reconciliation (workspace stayed accessible, no auth gate/redirect), matching the documented demo-only spec deviation

checks.criterion: Avatar menu and theme interactions remain stable
checks.name: avatar-menu-full-stability-flow
checks.evidence: Full sequence -- open menu, toggle dark, reload, reopen menu (state still 'On'), logout (toast shown) -- completed with zero pageerror/requestfailed events captured via page.on listeners; nav remained visible/interactive throughout
